ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota's Somali Community
ideas.description: Investigate allegations of fraud in Minnesota's Somali community and track the flow of funds
questions: What are the sources of funding for the Somali community?
How are these funds being allocated?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant financial irregularities and shed light on the allocation of funds within the Somali community. By following the money, we may be able to identify key players and patterns of fraud.
